original_value: This article examines adaptive multimedia and open educational game approaches for supporting language and literacy development in learners with language disorders and related special educational needs. The study emphasizes multisensory learning environments that strengthen comprehension, oral expression, vocabulary, reading fluency, and writing skills, while also considering cognitive and metacognitive assessment. It further discusses reuse, adaptation, and component-based design principles for educational games and interactive learning tools in inclusive settings.
